headline: Executive order lets federal agencies carry out certain sanctions created by a 2017 sanctions law aimed at US adversaries.
what_it_does: This order gives federal agencies the authority to put into effect certain sanctions listed in the Countering America's Adversaries Through Sanctions Act. That 2017 law set out sanctions aimed mainly at Russia, Iran, and North Korea. No summary was provided, so the specific sanctions and the agencies involved cannot be confirmed from the title alone.

who_it_affects.group: People, companies, and governments targeted under the 2017 sanctions law
who_it_affects.how: They could face sanctions that federal agencies are now authorized to carry out.
They receive authority to implement certain sanctions named in the law.

when_it_takes_effect: Likely upon signing on September 20, 2018; the title does not say.
